title: Some prints are gorgeous, others are meh
text: Some prints are gorgeous, others are meh. Over all this is an okay set of prints. The frames are all plastic and so is the “glass”. It comes with a protective sheet of plastic film you need to peel off before using. The quality of the print is crisp and clear and the gold leaf touch adds light and movement.  All the colors are vivid and the shapes are unusual. I think some of these prints are totally worthy of display and some just seem like filler pieces. I sort of get an 80’s hotel vibe from some of them. I only used 3.
